clue.text: Notes seating is provided

parts.note: so (or soh) is the fifth note of the sol-fa scale
fa is the fourth note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A concert programme promises that chairs will be available for the audience.
explanation.walkthrough: The one word 'Notes' supplies both pieces, two sol-fa syllables side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: A couch is a piece of seating for two or three people, so the word works as a synonym here.

clue.text: Firm, lean sort of soldier

indicators.note: to sort the letters is to put them into a new order, here those of the two words before it

explanation.surface: A description of a fit, wiry kind of military man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort of' looks like it qualifies 'soldier', but it signals that FIRM and LEAN are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A rifleman is an infantry soldier armed with a rifle, a specific example of the general term.

clue.text: Eager to go up after a key

indicators.note: after places the upturned word behind the key and the article

parts.note: G is a musical key

indicators.note: in a down clue, going up means the word go is read from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone keen to climb higher once they have found a key.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' works only because this is a down entry, where the word reads upwards from the bottom of the grid.
explanation.definitionFit: To be all agog is to be keenly excited and impatient, a synonym of eager.

clue.text: Swindle to reduce the rent?

definitions.meaning: a frame-up or con in which someone is cheated or falsely incriminated
a rent is a tear in cloth; sewing it closed makes it smaller

explanation.walkthrough: 'rent' looks like money paid to a landlord; it is a rip in fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: a con trick, and literally sewing a tear closed with needle and thread.

clue.text: Green Party finally contrived to get power

indicators.note: contrived means devised or worked into a new shape, so these letters are rearranged
finally points to the closing letter of the word Party

explanation.surface: An environmentalist political party eventually managed to win office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finally' takes Y, the last letter of Party; 'contrived' rearranges GREEN plus that Y.
explanation.definitionFit: Energy and power are synonyms in physics and in everyday speech, as in power for the grid.

clue.text: Pudding is seen to follow after

parts.note: spotted means seen or noticed
to dog someone is to follow after them closely

explanation.surface: A dessert is observed trailing along behind something.
explanation.walkthrough: SPOTTED DOG is a British steamed suet pudding studded with currants.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a traditional British suet dessert dotted with dried fruit, a specific example of a pudding.

clue.text: Like marquetry with fashionable Dali design

parts.note: in means fashionable, as in the in thing

indicators.note: to design is to arrange, so the letters of the painter's name are rearranged

explanation.surface: Describing a wooden panel decorated in a stylish pattern by Salvador Dali.
explanation.walkthrough: 'design' sounds like the artist's work but signals rearranging the painter's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Marquetry is decoration made by setting pieces of veneer into a wooden surface, so it is set-in work.

clue.text: Key pattern on a guitar?

definitions.meaning: the Greek key, an ornamental band of interlocking right-angled lines
the raised metal ridges across a guitar's fingerboard

explanation.walkthrough: 'Key' suggests music next to 'guitar', but the first sense is a decorative border.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both an architectural ornament of interlocking lines and a ridge on a stringed instrument's neck.

clue.text: Outstanding old part of a building

parts.note: a wing is a section projecting from the main part of a building

explanation.surface: An impressive historic section of a building.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Outstanding' looks like praise; here it means still unpaid.
explanation.definitionFit: An outstanding debt is one still due, so the words are synonyms in the financial sense.

clue.text: Metal key used by the cook

parts.note: tin is a metallic element
a key is something that opens a lock, an opener

explanation.surface: A metal implement that a chef relies on in the kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: A can-opening gadget is a kitchen utensil, so the definition describes it by who uses it.

clue.text: Reptile snarling at gorilla

indicators.note: snarling means tangled up, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A crocodile-like creature growls at an ape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'snarling' reads as growling but means tangling, signalling the rearrangement of AT GORILLA.
explanation.definitionFit: The animal is a large crocodilian, an example of a reptile.

clue.text: Treatise closely followed, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals that the word is judged by how it is spoken, not spelt

parts.note: to track someone is to follow them closely, so the past tense is tracked

explanation.surface: A learned essay that was studied in close detail.
explanation.definitionFit: A tract is a short pamphlet or essay on a subject, a near synonym of treatise.

clue.text: A short distance covered by light aircraft or jumbo in the past

indicators.note: covered by means the first pieces sit inside the aircraft's letters

parts.note: the de Havilland Moth was a famous light aircraft
mm is the abbreviation for millimetre, a tiny length

explanation.surface: A light plane flies a little way above an old jumbo jet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jumbo' suggests a jumbo jet next to aircraft; it is a huge prehistoric animal.
explanation.definitionFit: The woolly elephant relative of the Ice Age was enormous, so 'jumbo in the past' describes it.

clue.text: Got together, after a final check

definitions.meaning: paired up as a couple, as animals do when breeding
in chess, a king given a final check with no escape has lost the game

explanation.walkthrough: 'check' sounds like an inspection; it is the chess move that ends the game.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both paired for breeding and, in chess, beaten by checkmate.

clue.text: One who is deep in the letters of Freud and Eliot

indicators.note: the letters of means use only the letters of the two names, in a new order

explanation.surface: A profound thinker revealed in the correspondence of a psychoanalyst and a poet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deep' suggests profundity; in cricket it is a fielding area near the boundary.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket a deep fielder stands far from the batsman, so a player placed there is described as deep.

clue.text: Produced admitted superiority

definitions.meaning: gave as output, as land gives a crop
gave way or conceded to a stronger opponent

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to give a return, as a harvest does, and to give in to someone.

clue.text: Ventured again to take father out

indicators.note: to take means to receive something inside, here the father holding the other piece
out places the father's letters on the outside of the other piece

parts.note: dad is an informal word for father
re is a prefix meaning again

explanation.surface: Someone tried once more to take their father out for the day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to take ... out' reads as a day trip; split, 'to take' and 'out' say the father's letters go round the other piece.
explanation.definitionFit: To dare something is to venture or risk it, so the past tenses are synonyms.

clue.text: Opinion one can always go back on?

indicators.text: one can always go back on
indicators.note: going back on it means reading it backwards, and it reads the same that way

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A view that anyone can retract at will.
explanation.walkthrough: 'go back on' seems to mean renouncing a belief; here it means reading the word in reverse.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenet is a principle or belief held as true, a synonym of opinion.

clue.text: It's evacuated during shelling

parts.note: in shelling peas the case that holds them is emptied, though the surface suggests a bombardment

explanation.walkthrough: 'shelling' suggests gunfire and evacuation; it means removing peas from their casing.
explanation.definitionFit: The seed case of a pea is emptied when the peas are shelled, so the whole clue describes it.

clue.text: Barrels found around ancient dumps

indicators.note: found around means the barrels are placed surrounding the other piece

parts.note: drums are barrels or cylindrical containers
old means ancient

explanation.surface: Casks discovered near some old rubbish tips.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dumps' looks like rubbish heaps; it means low spirits, as in down in the dumps.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean a state of gloom or depression, as in being down in the dumps.

clue.text: Exclude use of foreign lawyers

parts.note: de is the French for of
the Bar is the collective name for barristers

explanation.surface: A ban on hiring lawyers from abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: To bar someone from something is to shut them out or prohibit them, so the words are synonyms.

clue.text: Live a moment with Dante's love

parts.note: to be is to exist or live
a trice is an instant, as in in a trice

explanation.surface: Spending a brief time with the woman the Italian poet adored.
explanation.definitionFit: Beatrice Portinari was the woman Dante idealised, who guides him through Paradise in his poem.

clue.text: Trouble with fog in vessel seeking shark

indicators.note: in places the rearranged letters inside the vessel

parts.note: a dish is a vessel for food

indicators.note: to trouble is to stir up or disturb, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A boat runs into difficulties in fog while hunting a shark.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trouble' reads as a noun; it is the rearrangement signal, and 'vessel' is a kitchen container, not a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: The small fish so named is a member of the shark family, an example of the larger group.

clue.text: Get up after midnight and complain

indicators.note: after places the waking word behind the letter

parts.note: the middle letter of the word night is G
to rouse is to get up or wake

explanation.surface: Someone woken in the small hours who grumbles about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'midnight' is the middle of 'night', the letter G.
explanation.definitionFit: To grouse is to grumble or moan, an informal synonym of complain.

clue.text: Bob all set for musical party?

parts.note: Hair is the 1960s rock musical
a do is a party or social function

explanation.surface: Bob is ready for a show-tune party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bob' looks like a man's name; it is a short haircut, which can be 'set'.
explanation.definitionFit: A bob is a short haircut, one example of a styled arrangement of the hair.

clue.text: Many tease girl about being a slowcoach

indicators.note: about means turned round, so the three pieces are read from end to start

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a large number
to rag someone is to tease them playfully
gal is an informal word for girl

explanation.surface: A crowd of friends rib a young woman for always lagging behind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns all three pieces round as one string; 'Many' is the Roman numeral for 500.
explanation.definitionFit: A dawdler who falls behind the rest is the same as a slowcoach.

clue.text: New or old slaver

indicators.note: new means made fresh, so the letters of the next two words are formed anew

explanation.surface: A figure from history or modern times, described by era.
explanation.walkthrough: 'slaver' looks like a noun for a person; it is the verb meaning to dribble saliva.
explanation.definitionFit: To slaver is to let saliva run from the mouth, the same as to dribble.

clue.text: Board of Trade?

definitions.meaning: a plank of fir or pine wood
to do business, buy and sell

explanation.walkthrough: The Board of Trade was a UK government department; the clue splits the name into two senses.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a plank of softwood and to do business or traffic in goods.

clue.text: River seen swirling backwards

indicators.note: swirling water churns things round, so these letters are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: A river is observed eddying and flowing the wrong way.
explanation.definitionFit: Going in reverse means moving the opposite way, so the phrase is a synonym of backwards.

clue.text: Violet and Virginia in oral exam

parts.note: Vi is a short form of the name Violet
VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia

explanation.surface: Two women named Violet and Virginia take a spoken test.
explanation.definitionFit: A viva voce is a university examination conducted by speaking rather than writing.

clue.text: Relax! Take a seat inside!

indicators.note: inside means the letters are found within the run of words Take a seat

explanation.surface: A host invites a guest to calm down and sit indoors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inside' reads as 'indoors'; it signals letters within 'takE A SEat'.
explanation.definitionFit: The command to be at ease, as given to soldiers, tells someone to loosen up.

clue.text: Port for mother after morning rest, perhaps

indicators.note: after puts the mother at the end, behind the other pieces

parts.note: am is the abbreviation for the morning hours

indicators.note: perhaps signals the word rest is one possible order of its letters

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal, especially a horse

explanation.surface: Fortified wine for mum after she has had a morning nap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Port' looks like the drink; it is a harbour city. 'perhaps' rearranges REST to STER.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dutch capital is a major harbour city, an example of a port.

clue.text: Bad habits that are difficult to get out of

definitions.text: that are difficult to get out of
definitions.meaning: clamping tools whose jaws grip a workpiece tightly

explanation.walkthrough: The second reading is the workshop tool, whose grip is hard to escape, like a bad habit.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both moral failings and bench clamps with screw-tightened jaws.
